Seen • Just now
My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
I'm sorry to hear your order arrived damaged. Here's what you should do:
Document the Damage:
Take photos of the damaged packaging itself, especially if it might indicate potential product damage
Take clear photos of the entire product and close-ups of the affected areas (such as punctures or indentations)
Include a common object close to the affected area to help show the scale of the issue
Take photos of the law tag showing the barcode (include both front and back if available)
Note the unboxing date
Contact Our Support Team:
Once you've documented everything, email the photos and a description of the damage to our support team along with your order details, email, and current shipping address. Our team will review your documentation and guide you through the next steps.
Processing time for replacement requests may take up to 7 business days, not including any production time needed to make the replacement item. If a return is needed, you'll receive a prepaid return shipping label via email.
Would you like me to connect you with a team member right now to help you report the damage?
